description: Fork of exp219 (qk_lut_init_std=0.02 + QK-norm + attn_scale=0.4 learnable, val_bpb=1.9694 @ 1400). Single change: drop the learnable attn_scale entirely. Use plain F.scaled_dot_product_attention with its default 1/sqrt(d_qk)=0.125 scale. exp001 uses milder pre-softmax std (~0.15) than exp219 (0.4) and trains faster — testing whether removing the 0.4 scale lets exp219 match exp001's training speed.
